input.summary:
Pocket B3 furnished in parts/room-9.mjs: a stock chest with a lit two-candle on it and a barrel in the west corner, two hanging lanterns (30,11,20) and (32,11,21); lanes at (31,z20) and the doorway cell x32 kept clear.
make.sh saved a whole build.nbt (room line: 5 placed, no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE). Light min 8 across the 6 floor cells.
Walkability holds only with the hatch passable: with the hatch at (31,12,21) left as is, mcd room says UNREACHABLE; with that one cell made air in a /tmp copy it says OK, 6/6 reachable.
left: mcd room / mcd walk report Pocket B3 (and every B and A pocket) UNREACHABLE in the real build.nbt: rooms.mjs PASS has no open trapdoor, so the open hatch at (31,12,21) (open:true, top half) is a wall to the walk; the pocket is OK once that cell is air. Fix belongs in the walk tool (add open trapdoors to PASS) or the hatch design, not in this part.
The part adds no element-checklist ticks: elements.md has no item for Pocket B3 itself (the pockets are under P1 'keeper pockets', RESERVED); plan.md's checklist is for parts, which the lead ticks.
Furniture is minimal by design: a 3x2 pocket with a ladder leaves five free cells, and the lane and doorway cell are reserved.

waste.what: Worked out the 3x2 pocket's free cells, lane and doorway-cell reservations by hand from the plan grid, and iterated the layout across three rewrites of room-9.mjs (first draft stacked layers wrongly).
waste.cost: about 3 full rewrites and a retry; layers() stacks rows from one origin, so each y level needs its own call
waste.tool: A helper that takes a per-y spec (y -> rows) and a room's reserved lanes from rooms.json would have avoided the stacking mistake and the hand lane check.

waste.what: Found the walk failure by hand: rooms.mjs PASS lacks trapdoors, so an open hatch blocks the walk. Confirmed by making a /tmp copy with the hatch cell unset and re-running mcd room, plus a manual grep of the walk source.
waste.cost: about 6 tool calls and 2 scratch scripts in /tmp/lh-b3
waste.tool: mcd room should name the blocking cell on the path (here the hatch at 31,12,21 and its trapdoor state), and PASS should accept open trapdoors.

companions.task: Confirm the B-pocket hatch (31,12,21) reads as a passable open hatch to players and the walk tool, so the pocket's entry works without a workaround.
